column1: # Outcomes of an unreadable row domain/break-glass/<cluster>. A row: path<TAB>reader<TAB>outcome<TAB>priority<TAB>unit<TAB>norm.
# path — the refusal path (JSON Pointer; "" — the whole row); priority — smaller is earlier; unit — the unit of unreadability.

column3: the whole row is unreadable: `w2cctl secrets seal`/`status` — does not touch the row (byte for byte), a log line «`<key>` unreadable» without the value, the walk continues, the result — code 1

the whole row is unreadable: at the member (the emergency entry of the cluster console) — the row exists but is not by the form or does not open — 503 unavailable, not counted toward the limit (the rule «Unreadable row» of the gate and pass contract; «Break-glass entry» step 4; OpenAPI of lesson 6, POST /session/break-glass); no row — 403 no emergency account; as a domain trace — the row exists (the section «Traces of the domain» of the same contract)

column3: the whole row is unreadable: at the holder — GET /domain/break-glass: the cluster key stays, the field of the row (`set_at`) is absent in its record — `{clusters: {<cluster>: {}}}`: the unreadable is not substituted by absence, the operator sees that the record exists and is broken, the break_glass field of the answer to the agent for this cluster is not sent in this pass, in sealed — held with the name break_glass, the member's copy is not touched, the cause goes to the log once per pass, without the value

the whole row is unreadable: the member's own copy — the agent, the only writer at the member, rewrites it by CAS on the version read with the value of the break_glass field of the answer, the cause goes to the log without the value; the field is absent in the opened envelope and this name is not in held — deletes, the name is in held — does not touch
revision is absent or unreadable: the existing row is unreadable; use this family's whole-row outcome for each reader; preserve its bytes, do not return revision 0 or write revision 1 over it
